newsitem.title: USA: US Postal Service has 15 to 20 pct of UPS business.
newsitem.headline: US Postal Service has 15 to 20 pct of UPS business.

text.p: The U.S. Postal Service estimated on Thursday that it is receiving 15 to 20 percent of the 12 million daily package business of the United Parcel Service, which is struggling under an 11-day strike by its Teamsters union employees.

"Many traditional UPS customers are looking to the Postal Service for their parcel deliveries even after the strike is over," said Nicholas Barranca, vice president of operations support for the Postal Service. He added that the Postal Service has experienced a steady increase in mail volume since the beginning of the strike.

"Express Mail, our overnight guaranteed expedited service, has increased 70 percent. Priority Mail, our expedited two-to- three-day service has seen a 50 percent growth and our ground parcel business has seen a 20 percent growth," Barranca said.
To deal with the added business volume, the Postal Service said it has hired more than 4,000 temporary workers.

Customers remain limited to four parcels per person per visit at any local post office. Customers wishing to mail five or more parcel post packages at one time may do so by setting up appointments at Postal Service drop-off centers by calling 1-800-485-8727.
